name: Monkey

app.note: No reference image shows a monkey. The scale is 1.1726 m for each unit, so the skull top is at 1.132 m, the standing shoulder joints at 0.59 u (0.692 m), and H is 0.334 m.

armFactorNote: The factor of the upper arm and the forearm. The arms of the mesh are short for the trumpet, so the factor 1.2 gives a reach of 0.384 m. The monkey plays a smaller trumpet at the scale 0.65 (SpeciesParams.trumpetScale, SPECIES_WIND_HOLDS.monkey of src/pose/winds.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. Do not stretch the legs: change the chair.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the tuft of hair, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The tail is a chain of two bones from the haunch over a bend behind the right foot to the tip of the curl.

studio.note: The monkey has no chair and stands in this pose (SpeciesParams.noChair). The thigh slopes 65 degrees down and 15 degrees out, and the shin slants 20 degrees back, so that the feet stand under the hips (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 65 15 -20). The trunk leans forward, so that the center of mass stays over the soles.

tail.note: The vertices within radius of the line of the tail bones, and behind the plane z = behind, follow the tail bones. The plane keeps the backs of the legs out of the tail.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the buttocks stay on the hips. This is the rule of the dog, moved with the joints of the monkey.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the round ears follow the head.

flip.note: The values of the rabbit and the fox.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh monkey --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

smile.note: The texture has a thin smile line, but each face takes the mean of its samples, so the line goes away. The band colors 5 faces of the lower lip and its corners in a mid brown of the fur. outward 0.6 keeps the side faces out of the line.

colors.note: A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples have a linear luminance below dark. The limit 0.02 keeps the dark brown hands and feet out of the dark faces. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a brown face in the nose box is the nose and takes the gloss.

chair.note: The app builds no chair under the monkey, but the rig needs a chair for the seat height of the export. The config has no sit rule, so the haunch keeps its form. The seat top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat.
